narrative.details: Head back to Belgrom in Orgrimmar and tell him Moktar be doing his bidding well out in the Thousand Needles. Tell him also, that me studies progress, and I hope to be havin' learned more soon. That should please him greatly.
narrative.objectives: Return to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I'm appreciative of your efforts, champion. The warchief will enjoy hearing how tenacious you have been in your duties.

Oh, of course I will mention your name to him. He speaks to me often and values my opinions greatly.

Go now, I have much to do. And if you speak to Korran soon, and he has news of these creatures, then return to me--I would think they are a threat that must be taken seriously.
